description: This file defines classes and methods for transforming and handling Anthropic Claude model messages within a Bedrock environment, including request transformation, streaming response handling, and chunk parsing.

classes.name: AmazonAnthropicClaudeMessagesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for handling Anthropic Claude messages with Bedrock, including request transformation, environment validation, and streaming response handling.

classes.name: AmazonAnthropicClaudeMessagesStreamDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for parsing Bedrock invoke response chunks into Anthropic /messages format, including usage metrics extraction.

methods.name: validate_anthropic_messages_environment
methods.description: Validates environment headers and parameters for Anthropic messages.

methods.name: sign_request
methods.description: Signs the request with appropriate headers and parameters for Bedrock invocation.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for Bedrock invocation.

methods.name: _remove_ttl_from_cache_control
methods.description: Removes 'ttl' field from cache_control in message content to comply with Bedrock.

methods.name: transform_anthropic_messages_request
methods.description: Transforms and prepares the message request, injecting necessary parameters and headers.

methods.name: get_async_streaming_response_iterator
methods.description: Creates an async iterator for streaming responses, decoding Bedrock events into SSE format.

methods.name: bedrock_sse_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps Bedrock streaming responses to ensure SSE formatting for clients.

methods.name: _chunk_parser
methods.description: Parses individual chunks from Bedrock response, converting usage metrics to Anthropic format.
